test_audit_trail_page_loads.title: The audit page shows its breadcrumb and its table's columns

steps.action: Open Admin > General and click View on the Audit Trail card.
steps.expected: The breadcrumb reads General > Audit Trail.

steps.action: Read the table's header.
steps.expected: The columns are Username, Role Type, Date & Time, IP and Action, in that order.

test_audit_trail_breadcrumb.title: The breadcrumb shows the navigation path

steps.action: Open Admin > General and click View on the Audit Trail card.
steps.expected: The breadcrumb reads exactly General > Audit Trail.

test_audit_trail_content_area_visible.title: Verify the Audit Trail content area is displayed

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Audit Trail - Users
steps.expected: Audit Trail - Users page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render
steps.expected: All page elements are loaded (no spinners or skeleton loaders)

steps.action: Scroll to the area where Audit Trail table should appear
steps.expected: The relevant section of the page is in view

steps.action: Locate Audit Trail table on the page
steps.expected: Audit Trail table is visible on the page

steps.action: Set up precondition: with audit
steps.expected: Precondition is met (with audit)

steps.action: Verify Audit Trail table displayed successfully
steps.expected: Audit Trail table displayed successfully

test_audit_trail_has_column_headers.title: The table carries the measured column set

steps.action: Open Admin > General > Audit Trail and read the table header.
steps.expected: Username, Role Type, Date & Time, IP and Action, in that order and nothing else.

test_audit_trail_has_records.title: Verify the Audit Trail has at least one record

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Audit Trail - Users
steps.expected: Audit Trail - Users page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for data to finish loading (spinners, skeleton loaders disappear)
steps.expected: All data sections have loaded completely

steps.action: Locate Audit Trail records on the page
steps.expected: Audit Trail records is visible in the expected location

steps.action: Verify the data values are populated and not empty or showing placeholders
steps.expected: Actual data values are displayed (not 'N/A', 'Loading...', or '---')

steps.action: Verify the data format is correct (numbers, dates, labels, etc.)
steps.expected: Data is formatted according to the expected display format

steps.action: Verify Audit Trail records populated
steps.expected: Audit Trail records populated

steps.action: Set up precondition: with valid data
steps.expected: Precondition is met (with valid data)

steps.action: Refresh the page and verify the data displays consistently
steps.expected: Same data appears after page refresh

test_audit_trail_record_has_date_info.title: A record carries today's date and a clock time

steps.action: Open Admin > General, click View on the Audit Trail card.
steps.expected: Audit records are listed under the Today range.

steps.action: Read the first record's date and time.
steps.expected: The Date & Time cell reads a real dd-mm-yyyy date no later than today, then | and a time as hh:mm AM or PM.

test_audit_trail_record_has_user_info.title: A record's Username and Role Type cells are populated

steps.action: Open Admin > General > Audit Trail and read the first record.
steps.expected: The Username cell names a user and the Role Type cell names a role; the Action cell names the same user.

test_audit_trail_record_has_action_info.title: A record's Action cell describes the activity

steps.action: Open Admin > General and click View on the Audit Trail card.
steps.expected: Audit records are listed.

steps.action: Read the first record's Action cell.
steps.expected: It is a sentence naming the user ("User '<name>' ...").

test_audit_trail_pagination_visible.title: The Today range lists its records on one page

steps.action: Open Admin > General > Audit Trail with its Today range.
steps.expected: The records are listed on one page: no pagination control renders and every row is a record.

steps.expected: The General cards are back, the Audit Trail card among them, and the breadcrumb is gone.
